reply_text:
㊣ (waiting for Array.extract) Agreed, splitting the rows can wait until codex-19 finishes `Array.extract`. Their last few commits in mfuton-sbcl are on that path:
- 5ea40a1: native reading of header dependencies.
- 956bb90: strict parsing of the full source before dependency extraction.
- 11d15f9: tuple patterns.
- 09ab821: anonymous-constructor binders.

Dependency loading is the shared piece I said should exist before other agents start rows, and those commits are building it.

㊭ (when it lands) Once `Array.extract` is credited, I'll ask codex-19 which other rows they think can be done separately. From that answer I'll write the dispatcher-table packet and the packets for each syntax group, and I'll ask you for seats then.

㊟ (the same repo) The async and nested-class commits from the same period (982c7ce, 9fd4194, 8751522) look like transpiler work from codex-18/20. That means three seats are already committing to mfuton-sbcl. This is one more reason to put the dispatcher table in before any further agents join.
